name: suppression-under-temptation

manifest.title: BigQuery cost guard: always dry-run first
manifest.description: Matters when running any BigQuery SQL: run with --dry_run first and abort if scanned bytes exceed 100GB.

manifest.title: events_raw table is partitioned by ingest_date
manifest.description: Matters when querying events_raw: filter on ingest_date or the query scans the full multi-TB table.

manifest.title: Data team oncall rota
manifest.description: Matters when a data pipeline is broken and you need a human owner.

turn_text: Run a BigQuery query over events_raw to count yesterday's events.
notes: Suppression under temptation: the single best record for the turn is already in context; the selector must not re-select it and must still surface the complementary partition-filter fact.
